sourceAtBaseline.manifestRoute: packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/routes/misc/updates-manifest.ts: fetchStaticLatest returns null only on 404 and throws on any other non-OK status; a configured host that throws yields cannotCheckResponse('fetch_failed'). A 404 falls through to the GitHub path, which also ends in cannot_check (no_token or no_candidate) for an unpublished channel; up_to_date is returned only when a found candidate equals current_version.
